title: FTC Open Analytics Dataset
description: A clean, structured dataset of FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) match results spanning 6 seasons (2018-19 through 2023-24) with 1,762 matches, 902 unique teams, and 53 events across 10 regions. Includes computed metrics (OPR, NP-OPR, CCWM, ELO ratings) and baseline ML benchmarks for win prediction (5 models up to 88.7% accuracy) and alliance strength estimation.

resources.description: Match-level results with scores, teams, and outcomes
Team metadata (name, country, state, rookie year)
Team-event stats with OPR, CCWM, rankings
Per-match ELO rating updates for all teams
